title: My Half-Brother Stole My $620K Sale And Left Me With A $3.8K 'Ink' Voucher. So I Voided The Sale
description: I poured my entire $99,000 widow’s inheritance into a letterpress studio with my half-brother, notarizing a 50/50 partnership. When a high-end stationery brand offered $620,000 for our presses and vintage wood type, he forged a sale document, pocketed the cash, and left me with a $3,800 'ink' voucher. I discovered the original agreement inside a locked type-drawer, voided the sale, and now he sets type in an apron that says ‘Pressed Lies’ while every card prints his fraud docket number. #familybetrayal #letterpress #quietrevenge
thumb_text: HE FORGED THE SALE, NOW HE WEARS PRESSED LIES
pinned_comment: If your half-brother handed you a $3,800 'ink' voucher after pocketing $620,000 from a sale you both built, would you have voided the deal or found another quiet revenge? Tell me what you'd do in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I FOUND THE ORIGINAL NOTARIZED AGREEMENT IN A LOCKED TYPE DRAWER
